offerings.name: Reader API (https://s.jina.ai)
offerings.pricing: Toy Experiment: 10 Million tokens, Free; Prototype Development: 1 Billion tokens, $50 ($0.050 / 1M tokens); Production Deployment: 11 Billion tokens, $500 ($0.045 / 1M tokens).
offerings.price_basis: 按 token 使用量计费；付费包从 Prototype Development 到 Production Deployment
offerings.free_quota: Every new API key comes with 10M free tokens; Non-commercial use only (CC-BY-NC).
offerings.output_type: 返回前五个搜索结果及其 URL 和网页内容；JSON 模式下为五个含 URL、标题、内容和时间戳的条目
offerings.note: 每次搜索消耗固定数量的 tokens，起始为 10000 tokens；免费/付费 Key 100 RPM，Premium Key 1000 RPM。
